lines_deva: ती॒व्राः सोमा॑स॒ आ ग॑ह्या॒शीर्व॑न्तः सु॒ता इ॒मे । वायो॒ तान्प्रस्थि॑तान्पिब
lines_iast: tī̱vrāḥ somā̭sa̱ ā ga̭hyā̱śīrva̭ntaḥ su̱tā i̱me | vāyo̱ tānprasthi̭tānpiba

lines_iast: mi̱traṃ va̱yaṃ ha̭vāmahe̱ varṷṇa̱ṃ soma̭pītaye | ja̱jñā̱nā pū̱tada̭kṣasā

lines_iast: ha̱ta vṛ̱traṃ sṷdānava̱ indrḙṇa̱ saha̭sā yu̱jā | mā no̭ du̱:śaṃsa̭ īśata
